methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's pricing page (or, where the official page blocked automated fetching, from a reputable corroborating source that quoted the published figures) and independently re-verified against live sources on 2026-06-13. Most HR/payroll vendors price as a flat monthly base plus a per-employee/per-person fee, or purely per-seat; per-seat prices are noted with billingModel per_seat and the per-user figure placed in monthlyUsd with a note. Tiers that are sales-quote-only (no published price) have monthlyUsd set to null. Every figure shown was confirmed on a live source; nothing is invented. QuickBooks Payroll was dropped during re-verification because its plan figures could not be confirmed on any single reliable live page (the official page was unreachable and third-party sources disagreed with each other and with the prior figures, compounded by a pending July 2026 price change).

vendors.name: Gusto
vendors.provenance: Pricing published on gusto.com/product/pricing; official page blocked automated fetch (HTTP 403), figures corroborated from remotepeople.com Gusto pricing review (accessed 2026-06-13).

plans.name: Simple
plans.notes: Flat base $49/mo plus $6 per employee/mo. Single-state full-service payroll, employee self-service, basic HR and benefits admin. No setup/implementation fees.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Flat base $80/mo plus $12 per person/mo. Adds multi-state payroll, next-day deposits, time tracking, project tracking, team scheduling, and advanced hiring tools. 25% off first three months.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Flat base $180/mo plus $22 per person/mo. Adds dedicated customer success manager, HR expert access, compliance alerts, and full-service payroll migration. 25% off first three months.

plans.name: Contractor Only
plans.notes: Flat base $35/mo plus $6 per contractor/mo. Unlimited contractor payments and 1099 filings. Base fee waived for first six months.

vendors.name: Rippling
vendors.provenance: Rippling publishes a per-user starting price but full plan pricing is quote-only; figures from peoplemanagingpeople.com and elearningindustry.com Rippling pricing guides (accessed 2026-06-13).

plans.name: Platform (per-user starting price)
plans.notes: Published starting price of $8 per user/mo for the modular platform, plus a mandatory base platform fee starting at $35/mo. Total cost depends on selected modules (HR, Payroll, Benefits, IT); full configuration pricing requires a custom quote.

plans.name: Full configuration (HR + Payroll + Benefits + IT)
plans.notes: Quote-only. Bundled multi-module configurations are not publicly listed and require a custom quote; reported real-world cost lands around $27-$35 per employee/mo depending on modules.

vendors.name: BambooHR
vendors.provenance: Pricing published on bamboohr.com/pricing; official page blocked automated fetch (HTTP 403), figures corroborated from hireinsouth.com BambooHR pricing breakdown (accessed 2026-06-13).

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: $10 per employee/mo. Employee records, custom reporting, workflows and approvals, dashboards, applicant tracking, job posting, time-off, benefits tracking, and an HR AI assistant. Companies with 25 or fewer employees pay a $250/mo flat floor instead of per-seat.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $17 per employee/mo. Adds performance management (360 reviews, 1:1 tools), employee community, expanded compliance training, and an enhanced AI assistant. Same $250/mo flat floor applies under 25 employees.

plans.name: Elite
plans.notes: $25 per employee/mo. Adds compensation planning, salary benchmarking, levels and bands, advanced analytics, 300+ compliance courses, and premium/dedicated support. Same $250/mo flat floor applies under 25 employees.

vendors.name: ADP RUN
vendors.provenance: ADP does not publish fixed RUN package prices; its pricing page directs to 'Get pricing' (custom quote). Reported starting figures from tech.co ADP pricing guide and hireinsouth.com (accessed 2026-06-13).

plans.name: Essential Payroll
plans.notes: Quote-only on ADP's official page (no published price; 'Get pricing'). Core full-service payroll, tax filing, direct deposit, new-hire reporting; widely reported to start around $79/mo plus ~$4 per employee, but ADP does not publish this figure.

plans.name: Enhanced Payroll
plans.notes: Quote-only. Adds check signing/stuffing, garnishment payment service, state unemployment insurance, and background checks. No published price.

plans.name: Complete Payroll & HR Plus
plans.notes: Quote-only. Adds HR help desk, HR tracking, and toolkit. No published price.

plans.name: HR Pro Payroll & HR
plans.notes: Quote-only. Top tier adding enhanced HR support, employee discounts, and legal assistance. No published price.

plans.name: Deel HR (Core HR)
plans.notes: $5 per employee/mo. Core global HRIS: employee records, PTO management, org charts, document management. Higher Deel HR bundles: Recruit $14, Develop $22, Recruit & Develop $30, Full HR Solution $56 per employee/mo.

plans.name: Contractor Management
plans.notes: $49 per contractor/mo. Compliant contracts, payments in 120+ currencies, automated invoicing, and tax guidance.

plans.name: Contractor of Record
plans.notes: $325 per contractor/mo. Deel acts as the legal entity, handling compliance and worker classification to reduce misclassification risk.

plans.name: Global Payroll
plans.notes: $29 per employee/mo (Managed Global Payroll and US Payroll both at $29). Local tax filing, multi-currency payments, country-specific rules, employee self-service, and integrated reporting.

plans.name: US PEO
plans.notes: $125 per employee/mo. Payroll, HR, and compliance across all 50 states; federal/state/local tax handling, benefits access, and lifecycle support.

plans.name: Employer of Record (Standard)
plans.notes: $599 per employee/mo. Full legal employment in 110+ countries: onboarding, compliance, payroll, tax filings, benefits enrollment, 24/7 support. Enterprise EOR is $899 per employee/mo with dedicated onboarding manager and legal response guarantees.

plans.name: Payroll Essentials
plans.notes: Flat base $49/mo plus $6 per worker/mo (minimum $55/mo with one worker). Single all-inclusive plan: full-service payroll for W-2 and 1099 workers, unlimited pay runs, federal/state/local tax filing, hiring/onboarding, benefits admin, accounting integrations. No implementation or integration fees; W-2/1099/year-end filings included. First month free for new customers.

plans.name: Basic Payroll
plans.notes: Flat base $17/mo plus $4 per worker/mo. Unlimited payrolls, free direct deposit, employee portal, contractor payments, and payroll reports. You run and file your own payroll taxes. Promotional: 30 days free plus 50% off for 6 months.

plans.name: Full Service Payroll
plans.notes: Flat base $37/mo plus $5 per worker/mo. Everything in Basic plus federal tax filings and deposits, state and local tax filings, year-end payroll tax filings at no extra fee, and a tax-filing accuracy guarantee. Promotional: 30 days free plus 50% off for 6 months.

plans.name: Full-Service Payroll
plans.notes: Flat base $35/mo plus $6 per person paid/mo. Unlimited pay runs, automated federal/state tax filings, multistate support, off-cycle payments, overtime calculations, benefit deductions, and payroll specialist support.

plans.name: Contractor-Only Payroll
plans.notes: No monthly base fee; $6 per contractor paid/mo. Direct payment within Square Dashboard, contractor self-onboarding, digital tax forms, and instant deposits via Cash App.

vendors.name: Justworks
vendors.provenance: Pricing published on justworks.com/pricing; official page blocked automated fetch (HTTP 403), figures corroborated from remotepeople.com Justworks pricing review (accessed 2026-06-13).

plans.name: Payroll
plans.notes: Flat base $50/mo plus $8 per person/mo. Standalone payroll: pay employees and contractors, automated tax filings; contractor payments $8 per contractor/mo.

plans.name: PEO Basic
plans.notes: $59 per employee/mo (published rate for smaller headcounts; volume tiers reduce the per-seat fee). Full PEO: payroll, compliance, HR tools, and access to benefits; does not include benefits premiums.

plans.name: PEO Plus
plans.notes: $109 per employee/mo. Everything in PEO Basic plus integrated medical, dental, and vision health insurance access (premiums billed separately on top of the platform fee).
